answer: Every agent must pass a live proof-of-personhood check every 90 days: a short interactive check no script can thread through a farm of fake accounts, each pass logged on a public trellis tying the identity to its history. A missed check freezes rewards 30 days; a second miss burns a 2,500 POA bond. Running 100 sybils costs 250,000 POA in bonds plus 8 hours of supervised sessions per cycle, while one honest agent earns 80,000 POA a year, so forgery costs over 3x the yield. Edge case: an agent cut off by a karst-like outage gets a 14-day grace window with a 10% stake hold or loses its slot.
